{{Top|leg}}
A '''beam cutter''' was cutting tool.<ref name="CC">[[Crisis on Cloud City (adventure book)|''Crisis on Cloud City'']]</ref> The [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] of the [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]] were equipped with low-intensity beam cutters during their mission to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They were not used on the underbrush, but became makeshift weapons after the team was captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who did not relieve them of the tools.<ref name="GG5-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> Beam cutters were installed on [[Scavenger Series Labor and Recycling Droid]]s.<ref name="TTDJ">{{JournalCite|10|Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)}}</ref>
